checks.name: no-zombie-positions
checks.origin: INC 09-07 (permanent regression) — no paper position may sit matured-but-unresolved beyond a settlement grace: a position whose settle candle fell outside the routine fetch window must be late-settled by targeted backfill, never left open forever with its stake locked out of cash

checks.name: decision-side-consistency
checks.origin: INC 09-10 (permanent) — every paper action must align with the model/policy decision OR carry an explicit registered override. A genuine sign inversion is: bet the model's LESS-likely side (p_side<0.5) AT negative edge AND not forced. Betting a cheap +edge tail or a flagged forced bet is legitimate, not an inversion.

checks.name: freeze-state-convergence
checks.origin: INC 09-10 (permanent) — when the invariant wall is GREEN and has been for longer than the daemon's fail-closed cache SLA, the desk must NOT still be holding a FREEZE that blames the invariant wall. Liveness of the safety state itself: a stale cached FREEZE after the wall recovers is a convergence bug.
